summary: Comprehensive frontend-only testing of Field Force Command Center admin dashboard (Vite React app at /app/admin-dashboard). All 6 tabs (Selling, Absen, Stock, Photos, Master, Audit) render correctly with full data-testid coverage. Global filter bar (region/area, single & range date modes, global search, reset), top-nav indicators (DEMO MODE badge, last-sync, auto-refresh toggle, manual refresh), kiosk mode (progress bar shows), and Export dropdown (PNG download verified; PDF button present) all functional. Selling tab: all 7 KPIs render with real mock values (Rp 358M omzet, 25.5% ach, 29.6% TR, 1139 trx, 32/32 active SPG), 3 ECharts + SPG performance table present. Absen heatmap, logs toggle, Stock inventory matrix + near-ED, Photos grid (48 cards) + lightbox selectors, all present. Master DB password gate: wrong password shows error, correct 'ADMIN' unlocks all 4 sub-tabs (manpower/stores/products/coverages). CRUD modal opens with 11 fields. Bulk Excel template downloaded correctly as template_manpower.xlsx with sheets ['Template','Panduan']. Bulk upload of custom xlsx (NEW+UPDATE+DELETE+duplicate PK) produced upload-report-modal with correct per-row results (3 SUCCESS, 1 FAILED 'Primary key duplikat di dalam file') and manpower table reflected UPDATE (SPG-001 renamed) and DELETE (SPG-002 removed). Audit tab: 20 approve/update/delete buttons, approve removes row + green toast, update opens edit-modal + save shows '-5 pts' toast, delete opens confirm-modal + confirm shows '-25 pts' toast; 33 discipline-score cells; leader-sla-tracker present with OVERDUE badges. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, all key testids visible, tabs horizontally scrollable. Zero console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid coverage is excellent and comprehensive across every interactive element.
Mock-data generation is relative to browser local-time (today may be sparse early AM) - documented in request; Date Range mode works around this.
Toast notifications on audit actions correctly show point deductions (-5 update, -25 delete) matching spec.
test_credentials: Master DB password: ADMIN (verified working; wrong password shows master-db-password-error)
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/test_bulk_manpower.xlsx (4 rows: NEW SPG-TEST01, UPDATE SPG-001, DELETE SPG-002, duplicate NEW SPG-001) matching downloaded template headers. All 3 valid actions succeeded, duplicate PK correctly failed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL https://field-force-cmd.preview.emergentagent.com. No backend involved (FastAPI untouched). Mock data is in-memory per browser tab, resets on reload. Use Date Range mode or yesterday's date in Single mode to see populated data if testing early morning. All data-testid selectors from the review request are implemented and functional. Bulk upload template downloads as template_<table>.xlsx with sheets ['Template','Panduan']; headers for manpower are [AKSI], spg_code, name, region, area, store_code, leader_name, leader_email, phone, monthly_target, status, join_date.
